name: What is the process for a room addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The room addition process typically begins with an initial consultation and design phase, where your needs and ideas are discussed and plans are drawn up. This is followed by securing necessary permits from local authorities like the City of Berkeley. Once permits are approved, construction begins, involving site preparation, foundation work, framing, roofing, utility installations (plumbing, electrical), insulation, drywall, and finishing. Finally, inspections are conducted at various stages to ensure compliance with building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves design, permitting, construction (foundation, framing, utilities, finishing), and final inspections.
